faqs.question: How do you learn new technologies?
faqs.answer: I prefer learning by understanding the fundamentals and then applying them in projects. faqs.question: How do you approach teamwork?
faqs.answer: I approach teamwork by communicating clearly, understanding the shared goal, breaking work into manageable tasks, and keeping interfaces between components well defined. In software projects, I also value code readability, version control, and clear API contracts so that different parts of a system can be developed efficiently.

faqs.question: How do you approach a difficult technical problem?
faqs.answer: I first break the problem into smaller parts and identify the actual source of the issue. Then I verify assumptions, reproduce the problem, check relevant documentation or logs, and test a focused solution. After solving it, I try to understand why the issue occurred so I can avoid similar problems in the future.

faqs.question: How do you make an AI application reliable?
faqs.answer: I focus on grounding the model with relevant information using RAG, validating structured outputs with Pydantic, controlling tool access, separating deterministic logic from LLM reasoning, and keeping application data outside the model's assumptions. Retrieval quality and clear prompts are also important for reducing unsupported answers.
